payload.summary: Ward Flow: the ward index renders 'no bed numbers' to a clinician, on a restraint with no recorded ruling
payload.detail: THIRD SUB-QUESTION under inbox request 26cefa10-5af3-4592-9d19-fca84beef03b (issueUlid 01M1NWXKM4CCK6050KCV03FK4C), same owner, same page, same sitting. Do not treat as separate work. (1) PROVENANCE, settled: the ward-index restraint — the digit ban, the 'All wards' wording, and 'not a second bed board' — has NO recorded owner ruling. Verdict UNTRACEABLE, deliberately NOT inferred: what is traced is where the CLAIM first appears (e06427196, 2026-08-29, one uncited sentence in the commit that built the page and its guarding test together), not where the BELIEF came from. A session may have been given an instruction and failed to cite it. Corrected in ward-index.tsx and tests/ward-nav.test.ts at 8c142a55f and b83ec642a; ENFORCEMENT UNCHANGED. Method calibrated first on a known-inferred rule (spec D4, withdrawn as R-2026-09-04-G) and a known-ruled one (coordinator override, recorded in a file with no owner- prefix) and got both right. Citing nothing predicts nothing: two rules in ui-ward-coordinator.spec.ts both cite no authority and one is RULED. (2) THE NEW SUB-QUESTION: the page RENDERS the phrase 'no bed numbers' to the clinician — it is in the test's fixed-copy allowlist. That is a page telling a clinician what it does not show, on the authority of a rule with no recorded ruling behind it. Milder than a banner asserting future behaviour, but the same shape, and it is rendered copy, so changing it is the owner's. NOT EDITED. (3) WHAT THE DECISION SHOULD ANSWER FIRST, and this reorders the two sub-questions already filed: the board renders '1 bed you can fill today' for headlineAvailable = min(allocatable, empty); mockup-ward-home.html renders '1 free of 20 beds' for the same figure. A bed can be empty and NOT fillable — the board's own comment records min(1,2). So the restraint's stated fear, wording that drifts, is ALREADY REALISED inside the artefact meant to resolve it. Ask 'free' or 'you can fill today' BEFORE 'strict index or card grid', because the wording question must be answered whichever way the layout goes. RECOMMENDED SHAPE, a recommendation and not a decision: if a figure lands on the index, share both the derivation and the SENTENCE — headlineAvailable() is already exported and read by the board, and constraintSentence() is exported and read by one surface. Single-sourcing the figure fixes the number and leaves the words free to drift, which is the half the restraint was actually about. A census of which surfaces state a bed figure in which words, and whether those words are derived from the figure or merely written beside it, is in flight and will size this.
payload.source: Ward Builder One, 2026-09-04, at Ward Lead's request — third sub-question on the ward-index sitting
